title: Sum of Total Strength of Wizards
summary: Given an array of wizard strengths, calculate the sum of the total strengths for all contiguous subarrays.
statement: Given an array of wizard strengths, calculate the sum of the total strengths for all contiguous subarrays. The total strength of a subarray is the product of the minimum strength in the subarray and the sum of all strengths in the subarray. Return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: For every nonempty contiguous subarray, multiply its minimum value by its element sum.
Add those total-strength values and return modulo 1,000,000,007.
Equal minima must be assigned consistently so every subarray is counted exactly once.
hints: Assign each subarray to one minimum index using previous strictly smaller and next smaller-or-equal boundaries.
Double prefix sums aggregate the sums of all subarrays containing that minimum without enumerating endpoints.
For index i, combine start_count*right_prefix_total minus end_count*left_prefix_total, then multiply by strength[i].
The monotonic boundaries partition subarrays uniquely, and the double-prefix algebra equals the sum of every assigned subarray’s element sum.
editorial: The monotonic boundaries partition subarrays uniquely, and the double-prefix algebra equals the sum of every assigned subarray’s element sum.

tests.explanation: The ten subarray total-strength values sum to forty-four.
